known_limits: Exact B1 Zoi bindings in older SceneZOI releases could suppress independent wildcard callbacks. SceneZOI 1.1.5 uses appearance components and passed B1/B2 receiver checks. Organized Crime mission compatibility has not been verified.
One active, controlled-initiator session with fixed membership; concurrent/NPC-autonomous sessions and predetermined watch-only sequences are deferred.
The manual picker accepts two or three Zois; bundled hubs require adult-compatible male/female appearance roles. Other rosters require compatible authored content.
Overhead bubbles are suppressed across the local UI, including nonparticipants; marker suppression is participant-scoped.
New facial poses, customized heads, meshes and furniture require their own fit tests. The female O was visually accepted; no new tongue asset was created or visually tested.
Furniture profiles support upright unit-scale objects with fixed placement offsets; all cosmetic variants, occupancy/menu routes and third-party combinations were not exhaustively tested.
Native mod-manager dependency enforcement/load ordering is not established by manifest declarations. SceneZOI must remain enabled for save-journal recovery.

World teardown may prevent a final event. An earlier interrupted-session record lacked a complete final acknowledgement trace; subsequent idle state, participant settings and bed release were read back separately.
